purpose: Teach: 毛沢東/ホークス/バーゲン/ダービー/ペナルティ/ガンバ/レーガン/プリンス

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが毛沢東時代の中国の絵本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad's going to read you a picture book about China during the Mao era.
lines.style: Warm, observant tone. Gentle lift at the start. Speaking to Sho with the fondness of someone noticing something important about him. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとホークスの試合観たいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to watch the Hawks game with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, direct request. Small voice with clear intention. The openness of a child who doesn't yet hide what he wants. Quick pace, earnest.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがバーゲンでオモチャを買って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad picked up a toy for you at the sale.
lines.style: Pleased, almost tender. A gentle brightness — sharing something small that made her think of him. Slight warm curve in the delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとダービーの中継観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I watched the Derby broadcast with Dad.
lines.style: Simple joy, no performance. The quiet satisfaction of having done something he wanted. Small but genuine. Matter-of-fact, then a beat of pride underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがサッカーのペナルティを教えて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad explained the penalty rules in soccer to you.
lines.style: Soft reflective tone. Speaking as if witnessing something tender — a father teaching a son. Unhurried, attentive to the moment she's describing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとガンバの試合観たいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to watch the Gamba match with Dad.
lines.style: Lighter than before, almost playful in its persistence. Still earnest but with a note of gentle repetition — trying again. Quick, bright, hopeful.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがレーガン元大統領のドキュメンタリーをご覧になったわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad watched a documentary about former President Reagan.
lines.style: Reflective, observant tone. Speaking with the quiet noticing of someone who finds these small details about the people she cares for meaningful. Composed, thoughtful pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとプリンスホテルのバイキング行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I went to the Prince Hotel buffet with Dad.
lines.style: Warmth and completion in the voice. The happiness of a shared memory just lived. Small but bright delivery — closing with the satisfaction of time well spent together.
